---
title: "Leaderboards"
---

Explore per-match leaderboards based on match stats. Use the filters to focus on a season or round, and set a minimum matches threshold to control who appears in the per-match rates.

```{ojs}
import {Inputs} from "@observablehq/inputs";
```

```{ojs}
rawStats = await FileAttachment("data/match_stats.csv").csv({typed: true});
```

```{ojs}
seasonOptions = ["All", ...new Set(rawStats.map((d) => d.Season).filter((d) => d !== null && d !== undefined))]
  .sort((a, b) => (a ?? 0) - (b ?? 0));

viewof season = Inputs.select(seasonOptions, {label: "Season", value: "All"});
```

```{ojs}
seasonFilteredForRounds = rawStats.filter((d) => season === "All" || d.Season === season);
roundOptions = ["All", ...new Set(seasonFilteredForRounds.map((d) => d.Round).filter((d) => d !== null && d !== undefined))]
  .sort((a, b) => (a ?? 0) - (b ?? 0));

viewof round = Inputs.select(roundOptions, {label: "Round", value: "All"});
```

```{ojs}
viewof minMatches = Inputs.number({
  label: "Minimum matches for per-match rates",
  min: 1,
  step: 1,
  value: 3
});
```

```{ojs}
filteredStats = rawStats.filter((d) => {
  const seasonMatch = season === "All" || d.Season === season;
  const roundMatch = round === "All" || d.Round === round;
  return seasonMatch && roundMatch;
});
```

```{ojs}
const numericValue = (value) => Number(value ?? 0) || 0;

function buildLeaderboard(rows, valueAccessor) {
  const totals = new Map();
  const matchSets = new Map();

  for (const row of rows) {
    const player = row.Player;
    const matchId = row.match_id;

    if (!matchSets.has(player)) {
      matchSets.set(player, new Set());
    }
    matchSets.get(player).add(matchId);

    totals.set(player, (totals.get(player) ?? 0) + valueAccessor(row));
  }

  const leaderboard = [];
  for (const [player, total] of totals.entries()) {
    const matches = matchSets.get(player)?.size ?? 0;
    if (matches >= minMatches) {
      leaderboard.push({
        Player: player,
        Matches: matches,
        Total: total,
        "Per Match": total / matches
      });
    }
  }

  return leaderboard.sort((a, b) => b["Per Match"] - a["Per Match"]);
}
```

## MVP votes

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(buildLeaderboard(filteredStats, (row) => numericValue(row["MVP Votes"])), {
  sort: "Per Match",
  reverse: true
})
```

## Aces

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(buildLeaderboard(filteredStats, (row) => numericValue(row.Aces)), {
  sort: "Per Match",

})
```

## Discipline (double faults + unforced errors)

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(
  buildLeaderboard(
    filteredStats,
    (row) => numericValue(row["Double Faults"]) + numericValue(row["Unforced Errors"])
  ),
  {
    sort: "Per Match",
    reverse: true
  }
)
```
